[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Donovan ''' was an officer of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on [[Quesh]]. When the [[Safecrackers]] got trapped behind enemy lines, Donovan briefed [[Havoc Squad]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] on his plan to save them from the Imperial Command Bunker.
